notes.title: HYPERBEAT Releases This Fall!
notes.notes: [p][/p][h1]HYPERBEAT Releases This Fall[/h1][p]It has been a while! At last, we have some exciting news to share with you all — [b]HYPERBEAT will be releasing this fall[/b]! It’s been a long journey since we started making this game, but we are almost ready to share with you the world that we have created. [/p][p][/p][p]If you didn’t catch it already, our Steam store page has been updated within the last week or so, featuring new visuals and info on new features that we’ve been developing! Our team has been hard at work polishing the game and prepping for final release. [b]More[/b] [b]news on the release date will be coming soon [/b]as we grapple with what is left, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]We have also opened up a Discord server! Come join us [url="https://discord.gg/7hNQbm82Vu"]here[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]In Seattle this August, you may have seen us at some events during PAX weekend — SLICE, MIX, and SIX. For any of you that stopped by our booth then, or during the Open Sauce convention in July in San Francisco, we hope that you enjoyed playing the game! The reception to the game could not have been warmer. If you want to support the game, you can check out [url="https://shop.dreamware.dev/"]shop.dreamware.dev[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely hope that you all share our excitement for exploring the world of HYPERBEAT. [/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned to our socials as we approach release![/p][p][/p][h1]Engage with the community[/h1][list][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/7hNQbm82Vu"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/bottinogames"]Twitter[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/bottino.games"]Bluesky[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]Eternity awaits![/p]

notes.title: Thanks everyone! Here's an update:
notes.notes:
Hey everyone—a giant thank you is in order—the reception to HYPERBEAT during Next Fest exceeded our wildest expectations! 

Thank you to all who played, wishlisted, and gave feedback. It’s been overwhelming to see so many people enjoying the game and to meet your expectations we’ve decided to move the release date to Q1 of 2025.

We want to make sure the game meets the level of quality you all deserve, and that we have time to address the feedback we’ve received to ensure HYPERBEAT remains something worth waiting for. While we’re entering the final stages of development, the current demo will remain live but all production efforts will be focused on the final build of the game.

We can’t wait to show you the rest of what we’ve been working on. 💚
